defs.def: the place from which a small piece of wood, glass, etc. has broken from an object （木头、玻璃等的）缺口，缺损处
a small piece of wood, glass, etc. that has broken or been broken off an object （木头、玻璃等破损后留下的）碎屑，碎片，碎渣
a long thin piece of potato fried in oil or fat 油炸土豆条；炸薯条

ex.s: Probably fish and chips, or a Sunday dinner of meat and two vegetables.
ex.t: 大概是炸鱼薯条，或者肉食加两种蔬菜的周日大餐。

ex.s: He eats fruit and vegetables rather than chips and fried chicken.
ex.t: 他吃水果和蔬菜，而不是薯条和炸鸡。

ex.s: Fish and chips from the UK consists of deep-fried fish and chips.
ex.t: 英国的炸鱼薯条由炸鱼和薯条组成。

defs.def: a thin round slice of potato that is fried until hard then dried and eaten cold. Chips are sold in bags and have many different flavours. 油炸土豆片；炸薯片

ex.s: Names of food Notes Hamburger • mix of + cultures Fortune cookie Nachos • chips covered in cheese • made by cook for Gumbo • invented in about yrs ago • a piece of with on it inside cookie • spicy stew • invented in N.O.
ex.t: 食物名称注释汉堡包•混合+文化幸运饼干玉米片•用奶酪包裹的薯片•由COOK for Gumbo制作•大约在几年前发明•里面有一块饼干•辛辣炖菜•发明于N.O.

ex.s: A student eating potato chips while watching TV.
ex.t: 一个学生一边看电视一边吃薯片。

ex.s: James's action plan: trying to (3) a bit Learning more about nutrition; Eating fewer chips and more (4) Going to an (5) with Laura; Spending less time on computer games and watching less TV; Getting (6) more.
ex.t: 詹姆斯的行动计划：尝试（3）更多地了解营养；少吃薯片，多吃（4）；和劳拉一起去（5）；花更少时间玩电脑游戏、少看电视；获得（6）更多。

ex.s: Mexican corn chips covered in cheese!
ex.t: 墨西哥玉米片上盖着奶酪！

defs.def: a small flat piece of plastic used to represent a particular amount of money in some types of gambling （作赌注用的）筹码
an act of hitting or kicking a ball high in the air so that it lands within a short distance 高尔夫球、足球等
to damage sth by breaking a small piece off it; to become damaged in this way 打破；弄缺；被损坏
to cut or break small pieces off sth with a tool 切下，削下，凿下（碎片、屑片）
to hit or kick the ball so that it goes high in the air and then lands within a short distance 尤指高尔夫球和足球
to cut potatoes into long thin pieces and fry them in deep oil 将（土豆）切条油炸
to put a microchip under the skin of a dog or other animal so that it can be identified if it is lost or stolen （为辨认而在狗或其他动物的皮下）植入微芯片
to join in or interrupt a conversation; to add sth to a conversation or discussion 插话；插嘴；（对谈话或讨论）作补充
to give some money so that a group of people can buy sth together 凑份子
